title: Yankee Swap Meet
logline: Michael's Christmas party Yankee Swap splits the Party Planning Committee, while Dwight wants the Assistant title and Michael learns what to give a temp who might leave.
outline: A: Michael hijacks Angela's Christmas party with a Yankee Swap, secretly rigging a gift for Ryan. B: Dwight's elaborate plan to be picked as Jan's inspection assistant; Jim sabotages. C: Ryan has a corporate interview and hides it; it slips out at the worst moment. Order: cold, A, B, A, C, B, A, C, A, B, A, tag
theme: Giving what you wish you'd get
storySoFar: Michael's dinner with Jan was canceled; Jan softened. Dwight campaigns for Assistant Regional Manager; Jim holds a real beet. Pam keeps Jim's lamp on, attends art class, told Jim she isn't sure about the wedding; Jim's stairwell/lot confession was interrupted; coffee promise stands. Ep 11: Christmas party civil war between Angela's committee and Michael's Yankee Swap; Michael secretly buys Ryan a thoughtful gift; Ryan's corporate interview is revealed; Dwight preps to be picked as Jan's inspection assistant. Finale next: Jan and David inspect, rumors of downsizing.

stateChanges.progress: Ryan has a corporate interview and let it slip; Michael gave him a thoughtful gift and said he'd be fine if he left.
Michael says he'll name an assistant for Jan's inspection; Dwight has prepared a binder.

stateChanges.text: Michael will announce his inspection assistant next episode; Dwight's binder is ready.
Creed's Yankee Swap gift is something unsettling nobody follows up on.
Jim's gift to Pam in the swap: a pencil set; Pam's gift hinted at the sketchbook drawing.

scenes.recap: Jim wraps all of Dwight's desk in Christmas paper.

beats.text: Question: why is my desk a present?
Early Christmas. Don't open it.

beats.caption: tears into his own wrapped monitor

beats.text: It's just my monitor. Wrapped. Why would anyone do this?
There's a tag on it.
'To Dwight, from Creed.' I knew it.

scenes.recap: Michael announces a Yankee Swap and Angela objects.

beats.text: Christmas party. Yankee Swap. It's like Secret Santa but with more stealing. Like marriage.
The Party Planning Committee has already approved Secret Santa. Twelve-dollar limit. Ham.
Angela, I'm overriding the committee. I'm the committee's father.
I already bought a Secret Santa gift. It's a scarf.
Technically, HR requires that any gift exchange be voluntary and—
Toby, nobody asked, and also, no.
Then the committee will hold a separate party. In the annex. With real cookies.
Actually, I'm now at two parties. Great.

lines: Michael is a tyrant. I have a binder and cats. Who has more power? Me.

scenes.recap: Dwight pitches himself as inspection assistant.

beats.text: Sir, for Jan's inspection you need an assistant. I have prepared a binder. Tabs.
I'll choose after the party. Everyone auditions in the swap. That's how Jesus did it.
False. But understood.

lines: I will win the Yankee Swap. I have a plan. Do not look for it. It is in my pants.

beats.caption: swaps Dwight's plan folder with a Christmas menu

scenes.recap: Michael secretly wraps a gift for Ryan.

beats.caption: wraps a small box in newspaper, hiding it

beats.text: Michael, what's in the box?
Nothing. A coaster. For nobody. Don't tell Ryan.

lines: I do not have a favorite. But if I did, I'd get him a gift that says, 'I know you.' And also, 'Stay.'

scenes.recap: Ryan lets slip his interview is Thursday.

beats.text: Why are you wearing a tie? Is it a date? Is it me?
It's an interview. Corporate. Tuesday. Do not tell Michael.
Oh my God. I'm so proud and so devastated. Can I be your assistant?

lines: I'm not hiding it. I'm just not sharing it. There's a difference.

scenes.recap: Dwight tries to cheat at swap prep; Angela helps.

beats.text: Angela, can I borrow your gift list? For research.
No. But it is by the third cat. Don't look at the cat.

beats.caption: opens his folder; it's a Christmas menu

beats.text: This is a menu. Where is my plan?
Is it ham? I hear it's ham.

scenes.recap: Two parties collide; the swap begins.

beats.text: Welcome to the Yankee Swap. Pick a gift. Steal. Be ruthless. Like Santa's elves.
There is a cookie table in the annex for those with decency.
I'm taking the gift card and going home.
I wrapped a jar. Of something. Don't shake it.
I got chili. Open it.
Whoever gets mine, wear it responsibly.

lines: I got Pam a pencil set. Good pencils. Not weird. Totally not weird.

beats.text: Ryan, good luck at your interview tomorrow! Corporate! Yay!
Interview. For what. A job. Another job. Than this one.
It's just a conversation, Michael. It's not a thing.

scenes.recap: Michael gives Ryan the gift he rigged.

beats.text: Ryan, you get to open last. Because I fixed it that way.

beats.caption: opens a leather portfolio with his initials

beats.text: For your interview. I knew. I always know. Don't be a stranger.
Thanks. Honestly. This is... good.
Question: where is my gift? I played the game.

lines: I got a mug. It says 'World's Okayest HR.' I think somebody liked it.

beats.text: I'm the best swapper. I stole six gifts. Name me assistant.
I'll announce my choice next week. For Jan. Be ready.
Dwight, you left your folder. There's a real plan in it now.

beats.caption: finds a beet in the folder

lines: Dwight's plan was to win. My plan was to be here.

beats.text: Creed, what's in the jar?
My old sheriff's badge. Not mine. Keep it warm.
Merry Christmas, everyone.
